scripts.text:
Select @XMLFileLocation = Value
From [EPA].EPA_SETTING
Where name like 'DRG-V_Letter:%'
And Active = 1

Select 
	LetterDate = Format(GetDate(),'yyyy-MM-dd')
	,Provider_ID = ''
	,Provider_TIN = COALESCE(TIN,'')
	,Provider_NPI = COALESCE(dv.NPI,'')
	,Provider_Name = COALESCE(REPLACE(ProviderFacilityName,' – ',' - '),'')
	,Address_Line1 = COALESCE(Address1,'')
	,Address_Line2 = COALESCE(Address2,'')
	,CITY = COALESCE(City,'')
	,STATE = COALESCE(State,'')
	,ZIP = COALESCE(ZipCode,'')
	,Phone = COALESCE(LTD.Phone,'')
	,Member_Subscriber_ID = COALESCE(SubscriberId,'')
	,Member_Name = COALESCE(MemberName,'')
	,Member_Claim_Number = CAST(COALESCE(ClaimNumber,'') as NVARCHAR(20))
	,Member_DOB = COALESCE(MemberBirthDate,'')
	,Member_Admit_Date = COALESCE(Format(DateOfServiceStartDate,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'')
	,Member_Discharge_Date = COALESCE(Format(DateOfServiceEndDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),'')
	,Total_Charges = COALESCE(Format(ClaimTotalCharge,'0.00'),'')
	,Paid_Amount = COALESCE(Format(PaidAmount, '0.00'),'')
	,Admit_Src	= COALESCE(admissionTypeCode,'')
	,Letter_Brand = COALESCE(DRG.LETTER_BRAND,'') --epa.csbd.letter_details.BrandName
	,Letter_Logo = COALESCE(DRG.LOGO,'') --epa.csbd.letter_details.Logo
	,Letter_Tag_Line = COALESCE(DRG.TAG_LINE,'') --epa.csbd.letter_details.Tag
    ,Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalDiagnosisCode_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalDiagnosisCode_Revised,'')
    ,Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryDiagnosisCodes_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryDiagnosisCodes_Revised,'')
    ,Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalProcedureCode_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(PrincipalProcedureCode_Revised,'')
    ,Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryProcedureCodes_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(SecondaryProcedureCodes_Revised,'')
    ,Org_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(DischargeStatusCode_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(DischargeStatusCode_Revised,'')
    ,Org_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(DrgCode_Orig,'')
    ,Revised_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(DrgCode_Revised,'')
    ,Audit_Rationale = COALESCE(RationaleDescription,'')
    ,Evidence_from_Medical_Record = ''
from [TRK].[Report].[vwCSBDDrgValidationCAPAReceived] dv
Left Join [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION] DRG ON dv.ClaimNumber = DRG.CLM_NBR
Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAuditType AD ON AD.Audit_Name = 'DRG Validation'
Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAddress LTD ON LTD.Audit_ID = AD.Audit_ID
Left Join EPA.[EPA_DRG-V_XML_Letter_Gen_Log] log On ClaimNumber = log.ClaimID
Where dv.[Provider_Addess_Active_Flag] = 1
And log.ClaimID IS Null


UNION 

Select 
LetterDate = Format(GetDate(),'yyyy-MM-dd')
,Provider_ID = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_ID,'')
,Provider_TIN = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_TIN,'')
,Provider_NPI = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_NPI,'')
,Provider_Name = COALESCE(CSBDF.Provider_Name,'')
,Address_Line1 = COALESCE(PV.Address1,'')
,Address_Line2 = COALESCE(PV.Address2,'')
,CITY = COALESCE(PV.CITY,'')
,STATE = COALESCE(PV.STATE,'')
,ZIP = COALESCE(PV.ZIP_CODE,'')
,Phone = COALESCE(LTD.Phone,'')
,Member_Subscriber_ID = COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Subscriber_ID,'')
,Member_Name = COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Name,'')
,Member_Claim_Number = CAST(COALESCE(CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number,'') as NVARCHAR(20))
,Member_DOB = COALESCE(FORMAT(CSBDF.Member_DOB,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'')
,Member_Admit_Date = COALESCE(FORMAT(CSBDF.Member_Admit_Date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'')
,Member_Discharge_Date = COALESCE(Format(CSBDF.Member_Discharge_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),'')
,Total_Charges = COALESCE(CSBDF.Total_Charges,'')
,Paid_Amount = COALESCE(CSBDF.Paid_Amount,'')
,Admit_Src	= COALESCE(CSBDF.Admit_Src,'')
,Letter_Brand = COALESCE(DRG.LETTER_BRAND,'') 
,Letter_Logo = COALESCE(DRG.LOGO,'') 
,Letter_Tag_Line = COALESCE(DRG.TAG_LINE,'') 
,Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes,'')
,Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Principal_Diag_Billed_Codes,'')
,Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes,'')
,Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Sec_Diag_Billed_Codes,'')
,Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes,'')
,Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Principal_Proc_Billed_Codes,'')
,Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Original_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes,'')
,Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Sec_Proc_Billed_Codes,'')
,Org_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(CSBDF.Org_Discharge_Status,'')
,Revised_Discharge_Status = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_Discharge_Status,'')
,Org_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(CSBDF.Org_DRG_Assigned ,'')
,Revised_DRG_Assigned = COALESCE(CSBDF.Revised_DRG_Assigned,'')
,Audit_Rationale = COALESCE(CSBDF.Audit_Rationale,'')
,Evidence_from_Medical_Record = ''


from TRK.[Case].[vwCsbdDrgFindingLetter] CSBDF
Inner Join EPA.PROVIDER_ADDRESS_LOAD PV on PV.TAX_ID = CSBDF.Provider_TIN 
Left Join [EPA].[EPA_CLAIM_DRG_VALIDATION] DRG ON CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number = DRG.CLM_NBR
Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAuditType AD ON AD.Audit_Name = 'DRG Validation'
Left Join EPA.CSBD.LetterAddress LTD ON LTD.Audit_ID = AD.Audit_ID
Left Join EPA.[EPA_DRG-V_XML_Letter_Gen_Log] log On CSBDF.Member_Claim_Number = log.ClaimID


Where 
1=1
and PV.ACTIVE = 1
and log.ClaimID is null 
and PV.NPI = CSBDF.Provider_NPI
